objectives.text: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker.  He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.
Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.

tooltip: Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 2.

objectives.text: Bring the Book: The Powers Below to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern, Ironforge.
Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

nodes.description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
nodes.name: Deadly Aspects

nodes.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
nodes.name: Bestial Wrath

nodes.description: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.
nodes.name: Frenzy

nodes.description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
nodes.name: Bestial Discipline

nodes.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
nodes.name: Intimidation

nodes.description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.
nodes.name: Spirit Bond

nodes.description: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 43 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
nodes.name: Summon Hawk

nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 16%.
nodes.name: Ferocity

nodes.description: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.
nodes.name: Improved Mend Pet

nodes.description: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.
nodes.name: Unleashed Fury

nodes.description: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.
nodes.name: Bestial Swiftness

nodes.description: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.
nodes.name: Improved Revive Pet

nodes.description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.
nodes.name: Pathfinding

nodes.description: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 4%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.
nodes.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey

nodes.description: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.
nodes.name: Focused Fire

nodes.description: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.
nodes.name: Endurance Training

nodes.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
nodes.name: Strider Kick

nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 15%.
nodes.name: Lightning Reflexes

nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 60%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.
nodes.name: Resourcefulness

nodes.description: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec
nodes.name: Lacerating Strikes

nodes.description: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.
nodes.name: Expose Prey

nodes.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.
nodes.name: Deterrence

nodes.description: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.
nodes.name: Surefooted

nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.
nodes.name: Survival Tactics

nodes.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13.3 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
nodes.name: Counterattack

nodes.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
nodes.name: Improved Wing Clip

nodes.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.
nodes.name: Clever Traps

nodes.description: Increases your total Health by 10%.
nodes.name: Survivalist

nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.
nodes.name: Savage Strikes

nodes.description: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.
nodes.name: Entrapment

nodes.description: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.
nodes.name: Deflection

nodes.description: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.
nodes.name: Improved Tracking

nodes.description: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 326 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
nodes.name: Sniper Shot

nodes.description: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.
nodes.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization

nodes.description: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.
nodes.name: Rapid Recuperation

nodes.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.  Turns off your attack when used.
nodes.name: Scatter Shot

nodes.description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.
nodes.name: Barrage

nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.
nodes.name: Mortal Shots

nodes.description: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.
nodes.name: Improved Serpent Sting

nodes.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.
nodes.name: Trueshot Aura

nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.
nodes.name: Rapid Killing

nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
nodes.name: Improved Arcane Shot

nodes.description: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.
nodes.name: Lone Wolf

nodes.description: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.
nodes.name: Careful Aim

nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.
nodes.name: Efficiency

nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.
nodes.name: Lethal Attacks

nodes.description: Gives your Concussive Shot a 0% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
nodes.name: Improved Concussive Shot

nodes.description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.
nodes.name: Hawk Eye

nodes.description: Increases your Agility by 15%.
nodes.name: Lightning Reflexes

nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.
nodes.name: Survivalist's Discipline

nodes.description: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.
nodes.name: Predator's Edge

nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.
nodes.name: Improved Stings
